producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: If access is fiber mass, blind GD over every size-3 skeleton should recover the fat zero target from more skeletons than the thin singleton. Equal skeleton counts reject that transfer at this bound.
decision: Accept phi_holds only if perturbed-correct succeeds and zero_gd > thin_gd. Equal counts reject Φ-predicts-unknown-skeleton-GD (min_size_governs). thin > zero kills it. Optimizer failure withholds.

gates.US4S_ENUMERATION: 80 size-3 trees; both targets have min_internal=3.
gates.US4S_PROCESS_IS_NOT_GIBBS: Recovery is GD on every skeleton, not a Gibbs sampler.
gates.US4S_PERTURBED_CORRECT: At least one perturbed-correct trial on the true zero skeleton succeeds.
gates.US4S_RANKING_RECORDED: The ranking is recorded and is not withheld_optimizer.
gates.US4S_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: The run does not claim the neural bootstrap.

kill_criteria.US4S_ENUMERATION: Kill if the size-3 count is not 80.
kill_criteria.US4S_EXACT_CONTROL: Kill if exact unweighted hits are not 2 vs 1.
kill_criteria.US4S_PROCESS_IS_NOT_GIBBS: Kill if the process is a Gibbs sampler.
kill_criteria.US4S_NOT_MATCHING_ONLY: Kill if only matching skeletons are tried.
kill_criteria.US4S_RANKING_RECORDED: Kill if the verdict is missing.
kill_criteria.US4S_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: Kill if the run claims the neural bootstrap.

audit_card.target_object: Blind GD recovery of two registered size-3 EML functions from every labeled size-3 skeleton.
audit_card.decision: Accept or reject: Φ still ranks unknown-skeleton GD. Matching-skeleton GD is a different process and is not reopened here.
audit_card.representation: All 80 VarTrees with 3 internal nodes; TEST_GRID from eml_variable_spectrum; same descend() as eml_us4_gradient.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Closed finite language fragment. Four registered seeds.
material_assumptions: The targets are the US-4′ zero identity and the same-size singleton.
Exact unweighted 2-vs-1 is multiplicity, not the unknown-skeleton claim.
A Gibbs sampler of the same trees would recover Φ by definition and is forbidden.
Matching-skeleton GD is already banked and is not this test.

objects.Skeleton: any size-3 EML tree in the variable-x grammar
objects.Recovery: MSE < 1e-6 after the registered GD on that skeleton
objects.n_gd_skeletons: number of skeletons with at least one successful blind seed

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Counts are dimensionless. Loss is MSE on the six-point grid.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: The banked ranking is the preregistered comparison of n_gd_skeletons. Exact unweighted hits remain 2 vs 1 and are not the claim.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the 80 size-3 trees and the registered seed list.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Real eml; 1-leaves learnable; x-leaves frozen; same optimizer as eml_us4_gradient.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: Perturbed-correct must succeed or the ranking is withheld.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Odrzywołek arXiv:2603.21852. US-4′ Gibbs and matching-skeleton halves for the targets.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Pretty-print is a gauge. The grid is a registered representation.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: Equal n_gd_skeletons rejects the unknown-skeleton transfer. thin > zero kills it.

compute.sampling: Exhaustive size-3 skeletons. No tree sampling.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as the preregistered ranking of unknown-skeleton GD. Not a Gibbs tautology. Not matching-skeleton GD. Not the neural bootstrap. Not a general architecture law.
